Method of Attack: Infostealer malware that infects victim computers to exfiltrate saved browser credentials, session cookies, credit card information, cryptocurrency wallet data, and other sensitive host information; distributed via Malware as a Service (MaaS) monthly subscription packages with command and control (C2) infrastructure and backend for managing stealer logs; distribution vectors include cracked software, phishing emails, malvertising, and advertising free video-game currency; stealer logs exfiltrated to backend infrastructure and distributed primarily via Telegram channels; used by initial access brokers (IABs) to gain initial access to company networks, which is then auctioned on dark web forums for ransomware affiliates
Impacted Systems: Victim computers infected with infostealer malware; corporate applications including single-sign on (SSO) portals, cloud environments, and other high-value applications
Attack Vector: Infection via infostealer payloads added to cracked software; phishing emails; malvertising; advertising free video-game currency; distribution through Telegram channels
